executiveAssessment.text:
Executive Conclusion. Hotel Phillips Kansas City, Curio Collection by Hilton reaches many monitored demand scenarios, but consideration consistency is the binding constraint.

What the Data Is Telling Us. Scenario Presence is 73% while AI Consideration is 31.3%. The hotel is therefore relevant across a wide share of monitored traveler needs, yet it is not carried into individual answers nearly as consistently. Softness concentrates in Wellness versus stronger Couples / Romantic Stay. Loews Kansas City Hotel often fills absences in those weaker contexts. That contrast is more important than either metric alone.

Why It Matters. Broad scenario reach without consistent answer-level inclusion means the hotel is known in the demand set but not reliably carried into traveler-facing answers. Management attention should start with consistency of representation, not with assuming the hotel needs an entirely new competitive set.

Where the Pattern Is Concentrated. Group / Meeting shows the softest Scenario Capture (63.6%), while Couples / Romantic remains stronger (88.9%). That contrast supports a concentrated softness reading — not a uniform demand failure. Loews Kansas City Hotel most often appears when the hotel is absent (12 scenarios) — useful for source and fact reconciliation, not as proof of cause. Reality Coverage is 33.3% (3/9 attributes). Material gaps include Fitness Center; Pet-Friendly; Business Center.

What Management Should Focus On Now. Focus first on consistency of representation for Wellness. Confirm priority sources present the same use cases and attributes that appear in scenarios where the hotel is absent, and close gaps that repeatedly coincide with answer-level misses.

What Not to Overreact To. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet. This period can be evaluated on its own; change over time is not shown.

What to Review Next. Compare high-presence versus low-consideration scenarios and inspect which sources and attributes appear when the hotel is missing. Use that evidence pack before changing channel strategy.
